cases.text: Nobody sits beside this cloud box, so a question in the chat meets nobody. Where you can decide, decide, and say what you weigh and assume. Where a person alone can, mint a ticket on the person route: `./RUNME.sh mint ticket spec/tickets/<name>.md --process=person`. cases.text: The owner sent a prompt, and nothing has answered it. Answer it before the next tool call: write it in the chat as text, which pays this door the moment the chat shows it. cases.name: an Agent call naming no tier's model refuses
cases.text: This Agent call names model sonnet, a model of no tier. Every `Agent` call names `model` by the tier of the work it hands. find takes `haiku`: find, list, read and report: work you check by looking. change takes `opus`: a scoped change in one to three files with its test, or a review against a list. decide takes `opus`: a design, a cause nobody knows, a change across modules, or a verdict the owner reads. Where you doubt, take the next tier up.
